description: Unique name of the RDS database instance.
Database engine running on the instance, e.g. mysql, postgres, aurora.
The RDS instance class/size, e.g. db.t3.medium. Determines the hourly compute rate.
Amount of storage provisioned for the instance, in gigabytes. Billed regardless of actual usage.
Whether the instance is deployed across multiple availability zones for high availability. Roughly doubles compute cost when true.
Number of hours the instance was active during the billing period.
Combined compute and storage cost for this instance during the billing period, in USD.
